skills.name: aitopia-brand-kit
skills.description: Build a brand kit with AITOPIA: logo direction, color palette, typography and usage rules.
skills.description_zh: 使用 AITOPIA 建立品牌套件，包括标志方向、色板、字体及使用规则。

skills.name: aitopia-edit
skills.description: Edit video and audio with AITOPIA: join clips, add voiceover or music, trim, resize to 9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1, add text or a logo, subtitles, fades, speed changes, mute or extract audio, animate a still image. Use for any media editing request.
skills.description_zh: 使用 AITOPIA 编辑视频和音频：拼接、配音配乐、裁剪、转换 9:16/16:9/1:1、加文字标志字幕、淡入淡出、变速、静音或提取音轨，以及让静态图片动起来。

skills.name: aitopia-generate
skills.description: Generate images, video, voiceover, music or sound effects with AITOPIA. Use when the user asks to create, draw, render or animate something (e.g. "make an image of…", "a 5 second video of…", "a voiceover for…").
skills.description_zh: 使用 AITOPIA 生成图片、视频、配音、音乐或音效，适用于创建、绘制、渲染和动画请求。

skills.name: aitopia-product-ad
skills.description: Create a product advertisement / commercial from a product photo with AITOPIA (hero keyframe, motion, voiceover, music).
skills.description_zh: 用 AITOPIA 从产品照片制作广告，包含主视觉关键帧、动态效果、配音与音乐。

skills.name: aitopia-short-video
skills.description: Produce a short-form video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, launch or promo video) end to end with AITOPIA.
skills.description_zh: 用 AITOPIA 端到端制作 TikTok、Reels、Shorts、发布或推广短视频。

skills.name: aitopia-ugc-video
skills.description: Create a creator-style UGC ad (testimonial, before-after, hook video, natural phone-shot feel) with AITOPIA.
skills.description_zh: 用 AITOPIA 制作创作者风格 UGC 广告，如用户证言、前后对比、开场钩子视频及自然手机拍摄质感。

skills.name: aitopia-upload
skills.description: Upload a local file (photo, video, audio, document) to AITOPIA so AITOPIA tools can use it. Use when the user points at a file on their computer for an AITOPIA job, e.g. "remove the background of ./photo.png".
skills.description_zh: 将本地图片、视频、音频或文档上传到 AITOPIA，供其工具用于用户指定的媒体任务。

skills.name: aitopia-youtube-thumbnail
skills.description: Design high click-through YouTube thumbnails with AITOPIA: bold subject, high contrast, big readable text.
skills.description_zh: 用 AITOPIA 设计高点击率方向的 YouTube 缩略图，采用醒目主体、高对比和大号易读文字。
